mapper.select: SELECT FROM adhoc_executor_instance WHERE status='UP' AND accepting=1 ORDER BY load_score ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM adhoc_executor_instance WHERE status='UP' AND accepting=1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{engineType}, engine_types) ORDER BY load_score ASC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM adhoc_executor_instance WHERE status='UP' AND accepting=1 AND FIND_IN_SET(#{engineType}, engine_types) ORDER BY load_score ASC
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO adhoc_executor_instance (instance_id, host, grpc_port, status, accepting, start_time, version, heartbeat_time, engine_types, max_concurrent_tasks) VALUES (#{instanceId},#{host},#{grpcPort},'UP',1,NOW(),#{version},NOW(),#{engineTypes},#{maxConcurrentTasks}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE status='UP', accepting=1, start_time=NOW(), heartbeat_time=NOW(), version=VALUES(version), engine_types=VALUES(engine_types)
mapper.update: UPDATE adhoc_executor_instance SET heartbeat_time=NOW(), status='UP', running_tasks=#{runningTasks}, cpu_usage=#{metrics.cpuUsage}, mem_usage=#{metrics.memUsage}, disk_usage=#{metrics.diskUsage}, cpu_usage_pct=#{metrics.cpuUsagePct}, system_cpu_usage_pct=#{metrics.systemCpuUsagePct}, memory_usage_pct=#{metrics.memoryUsagePct}, memory_used_mb=#{metrics.memoryUsedMb}, memory_max_mb=#{metrics.memoryMaxMb}, thread_count=#{metrics.threadCount}, last_gc_pause_ms=#{metrics.lastGcPauseMs}, heap_committed_mb=#{metrics.heapCommittedMb}, non_heap_used_mb=#{metrics.nonHeapUsedMb}, non_heap_committed_mb=#{metrics.nonHeapCommittedMb}, daemon_thread_count=#{metrics.daemonThreadCount}, gc_count=#{metrics.gcCount}, gc_time_ms=#{metrics.gcTimeMs}, gc_time_ratio_pct=#{metrics.gcTimeRatioPct}, loaded_class_count=#{metrics.loadedClassCount}, uptime_ms=#{metrics.uptimeMs}, load_score=#{metrics.loadScore} WHERE instance_id=#{instanceId}
UPDATE adhoc_executor_instance SET status='DOWN', last_down_time=NOW() WHERE status='UP' AND heartbeat_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{seconds} SECOND
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM adhoc_executor_instance WHERE status='DOWN' AND last_down_time < NOW() - INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR
mapper.select: SELECT instance_id AS instanceId, host AS host, grpc_port AS grpcPort, status AS status, accepting AS accepting, IFNULL(JSON_LENGTH(running_tasks), 0) AS runningTasks, max_concurrent_tasks AS maxConcurrent, IFNULL(TIMESTAMPDIFF(SECOND, heartbeat_time, NOW()), 0) AS heartbeatAgeSec, IFNULL(cpu_usage_pct, 0) AS cpuUsagePct, IFNULL(system_cpu_usage_pct, 0) AS systemCpuUsagePct, IFNULL(memory_usage_pct, 0) AS memoryUsagePct, IFNULL(memory_used_mb, 0) AS memoryUsedMb, IFNULL(memory_max_mb, 0) AS memoryMaxMb, IFNULL(heap_committed_mb, 0) AS heapCommittedMb, IFNULL(non_heap_used_mb, 0) AS nonHeapUsedMb, IFNULL(non_heap_committed_mb, 0) AS nonHeapCommittedMb, IFNULL(thread_count, 0) AS threadCount, IFNULL(daemon_thread_count, 0) AS daemonThreadCount, IFNULL(gc_count, 0) AS gcCount, IFNULL(gc_time_ms, 0) AS gcTimeMs, IFNULL(gc_time_ratio_pct, 0) AS gcTimeRatioPct, IFNULL(loaded_class_count, 0) AS loadedClassCount, IFNULL(uptime_ms, 0) AS uptimeMs, IFNULL(load_score, 0) AS loadScore FROM adhoc_executor_instance ORDER BY status ASC, load_score ASC
